svg.title: Known-best packing of 304 unit squares
svg.desc: The retained known-best n=304 construction, normalized to Witness/v2 and rendered with the repository's deterministic house renderer.

sqpack:profile.sqpack:value: Complete bb4cc78 rational centre/half-angle certificates, read exactly from the retained source files. Finite construction feasibility only; no KKT, local minimum, same-packing, rigidity, novelty, priority or global optimality claim.

svg.text: U n=304 known best: side ~ 17.92094409 (certified upper bound)
